item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Sun 22:00): The Global Story: Smart glasses or ‘pervert glasses’?
item.description:
Originally published Sun 11 Oct 2026 22:00 IDT.

At a recent Meta product launch, Mark Zuckerberg promised that the company’s smart glasses would give wearers “new superpowers”, but what are they? Amid criticisms of its privacy and child protection policies, Meta is betting big on smart glasses as a way to restyle the company’s image, but they too have caused controversy – dubbed by critics ‘pervert glasses’ because they have been used to film women without their knowledge. So why are Meta and other big tech firms investing billions in this tech? Who is it for? Lily Jamali, the BBC’s North America technology correspondent, joins us to explain.

For more episodes, just search 'The Global Story' wherever you get your BBC Podcasts.
